top_signals.title: Refining-Stocks Rally Stalls as Talk of Diesel Export Ban Swirls
top_signals.summary: This year’s big rally in US refiner stocks is running into growing headwinds with some Republican leaders calling to restrict exports of diesel, which has soared as global conflicts limit supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Record-low Rhine levels choke barge traffic, stress ground transport
top_signals.summary:
Germany and other countries in central Europe are dealing with high freight transportation costs and supply chain delays because extremely low water levels on the Rhine River, and other tributaries, are curtailing barge traffic.

top_signals.title: Santoli: The S&P 500 is within striking distance of record as bull relies on familiar leadership
top_signals.summary: Rerun generation, Gen X, seems obsessed with finding parallels between today's market and past cycles, Mike Santoli writes.

top_signals.title: Seoul’s green space is a battleground for its mayor and South Korea’s president
top_signals.summary: The clash reflects a global urban-policy conundrum: how cities can manage housing shortages without destroying liveability and environmental health.
